reasons: The rule expects an insurance covenant from a hosting/data-processing vendor; the cited document contains only an incidental 'insurance' reference in the taxes/charges provision, which imposes no coverage obligation, so a 'missing' classification is appropriate (below even the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback).

The inserted paragraph (l) tracks the playbook model language closely (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to hosting/processing Licensee data, workers' comp, certificates on request), is directionally correct in favor of the Customer, and is placed sensibly in the General Provisions section immediately after (k) without altering existing text.

Comment is concise, first-person plural, cites the playbook position, explains the insertion and offers the fallback limits; deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and an insurance obligation is present.
